{{Tabs|History = No}} {{For|other uses of [[Ice (Disambiguation)|Ice]]| the [[Turret]]|[[Gatling Gun]]|}} {{UnitInfobox |image-static = IceTurret.png |image-dynamic = IceTurretDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Elementalist]] |level = 3 |type = Sentry |lifespan = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Lifespan]]45 |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]1,000 |damage_type = Single |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]10 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.45 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]10 |hidden = N/A |lead = N/A |flying = N/A }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Ice Turret''' is a unit that is spawned by the [[Elementalist]]. It spawns when the ''Ice Turret'' ability is used at Levels 2-4 when the [[Elementalist]] is set to its frost mode. It does not spawn on the path and instead is spawned within the [[Elementalist]]'s range. The '''Ice Turret''' will fire at enemies in its range, applying chillness to them. Upon reaching max chillness, the enemy will be frozen for two seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Ice Turret''' is a tripod device constructed out of metal, colored grey and white with multiple neon blue parts. It has a mounted freeze rifle, which it fires at enemies with. ==Statistics== {{neow| $DPS$ = Damage / Firerate
{| class="wikitable stats-table" ! Level !! Health !! Damage !! Firerate !! Range !! Slowdown per Hit !! Max Slowdown !! Slowdown Time !! Freeze Time !! Lifespan !! DPS |- | 2 || 1,000 || 10 || 0.45 || 10 || 2.5% || 15% || 5 || 2 || 45 || $DPS$ |- | 3 || 1,000 || 20 || 0.35 || 12.5 || 5% || 15% || 5 || 2 || 45 || $DPS$ |- | 4 || 1,000 || 28 || 0.3 || 15 || 5% || 20% || 5 || 2 || 45 || $DPS$ |}
}} ==Strategy== *Due to its relatively short range, the '''Ice Turret''' is most effective when built on loops, turns, or areas where enemies cross over more than once. **This is only accessible if the [[Elementalist]] has its range covered at such locations. *The '''Ice Turret''' can be quite effective at dealing damage to high health enemies like the [[Elite Abnormal]] and [[Molten Golem]], while also doing well against hordes of weaker enemies like the [[Hazmat]]. *The '''Ice Turret''' does not have hidden detection, meaning you have to either rely on the [[Elementalist]] or other towers for hidden detection. *The '''Ice Turret''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. *The '''Ice Turret''' has an extremely high amount of health, meaning that it is unlikely to be killed by a lot of enemy abilities, though it is not completely invincible. **While the [[Boomer]] cannot kill it with its 400 damage explosion, the [[Brute]] can with its 1,000 damage ''Smash''. ==Trivia== *The '''Ice Turret''' is currently the only unit that can freeze and chill enemies. *The '''Ice Turret''' originally had 1 health which was the lowest health out of any unit. *The '''Ice Turret''' is the only unit without a visible health bar. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' -
